description: This file implements system logging functionality for Windows, providing functions to open a log connection and send log messages via the Windows Event Log API. It defines internal state for the event log handle, and includes details for formatting messages and handling external Windows API calls.

methods.name: void openlog(const char * ident,int logopt UNUSED,int facility UNUSED)
methods.description: Initializes the Windows Event Log source using the provided identifier, avoiding reinitialization if already set.

methods.name: void syslog(int priority,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a log message, handles special sequences, and sends it to the Windows Event Log with appropriate severity.
